name: Facewow
desc: AI portrait studio for headshots, avatars and photo restoration
desc_zh: 做证件照、头像和照片修复的 AI 人像工作室
solves: A studio headshot costs money and a slot in the calendar; Facewow produces one from a phone photo in a few minutes.
solves_zh: 影棚证件照既要花钱又要排期；Facewow 用手机照片几分钟就能出一张。
best_for: Your LinkedIn photo is five years old and a recruiter page opens in an hour.
best_for_zh: LinkedIn 头像还是五年前的，而一小时后就要打开招聘页面时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：A — Apple App Store developer catalogue for Chengdu Everimaging Science and Tech）。 Missing from the ledger. The vendor also ships a second app, 'Facewow: AI Avatar Generator' (App Store id 6478918807, released 2024-05-14), which is the same product family and is not filed separately. The App Store metadata is the only place the vendor publishes a first-public-availability date, so the machine-readable official listing (iTunes lookup API, Apple's own endpoint) is used as the primary source and the quotes are copied verbatim from that JSON.
